data: First human-made object to reach the Martian surface; lander crashed on impact (1971)
Skeleton entry for /fleet (PRD-012 v0.2 / Phase A scaffold). Builder + agency + first-flight per public sources. Specs and gallery TBD in later phases.
First human-made object to reach Mars surface; lander crashed (1971)

The first human-made object to reach the Martian surface — by hard impact. The descent module crashed during the 1971 dust storm that obscured every other Mars probe in orbit at the time. Companion Mars 3 made the first soft landing two days later.
First soft landing on Mars; 14.5 s of surface transmission
First soft landing on another planet and first to transmit data from another planet's surface (Venus, 1970)
Soviet 1973 Mars lander — first descent telemetry from Mars atmosphere (224 s, mostly corrupted)
First soft landing on another world
Last successful Soviet Moon mission — returned 170 g of Mare Crisium regolith 1976-08-22; last lunar sample return until Chang'e 5

First human-built object to reach the Martian surface — by impact. The lander's parachute failed during EDL on 27 November 1971; it crashed at high speed in the Hellas region. The orbiter component continued to return data for eight months. Mars 2 began the Soviet attempt to leapfrog the Americans to the Martian surface in the 1971 launch window.
